maintenance_led.reason: Sells canned fruits and vegetables, consumable food products, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue mainly from retail, foodservice, and industrial customers; the government (e.g., USDA commodity programs) is a minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own vertically integrated processing and sales of canned vegetables; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Canned vegetables and fruit are largely commodity food products; customers can switch suppliers easily.
